sloka: अवलिप्ते न जानासि त्वत्तः प्रियतरो मम ।मनुजो मनुजव्याघ्राद्रामादन्यो न विद्यते ॥२-११-५॥
transliteration: avalipte na jānāsi tvattaḥ priyataro mama ।manujo manujavyāghrādrāmādanyo na vidyate ॥2-11-5॥

translations.english: O proud lady, don't you know there exists for me no woman dearer than you and no man other than Rama who is the best among men.
